Rank 13 and rank 16 both bucket states with '1 National Park' — TN, NC, OR at rank 13 but NM, NV, ND, AR, KY, OH, MI, MN, ME, VA, WV, SC, IN, MO at rank 16. All have the same count (1). Either all should be tied at rank 13 (jumping to rank 16 for next distinct value), or none should be. Also TN/NC share Great Smoky (single park spanning two states) — the 'tied w/ NC'/'tied w/ TN' annotation is inconsistent with treating each state as having 1 park independently.
